    Why buy from Rippa Victoria

    We are the Rippa dealer for Victoria. You buy from a person you can ring, and the machine gets set up before it leaves the yard.

    • Honest sizing

      Most people buy a size too big or too small. Tell us the jobs and the access and we will tell you which machine, even if it is the cheaper one.

    • Set up before delivery

      Every machine is fluid-checked, torqued, run in and tested before it goes on the trailer. See the full list below.

    • Parts and support in Victoria

      Filters, pins, teeth and hoses in stock locally. If something goes wrong you ring Min, not an overseas call centre.

    • Delivery across the state

      We deliver across Melbourne and regional Victoria, and can quote delivery interstate.

    What the pre-delivery service covers

    A new machine off the ship is not ready to work. This is what we do to every one before you get it.

    • Every fluid checked and topped: engine oil, hydraulic oil, coolant, grease points.
    • Track tension set and all track bolts torqued.
    • Every hose and fitting checked under pressure for leaks.
    • Controls tested through the full range, including the swing boom and thumb.
    • Engine run in and serviced before it leaves the yard.
    • Attachments fitted and checked on the hitch.
    • A walk-through with you at handover, in person or on video.
